full_judgment: "In our opinion in the facts and circumstances of the present case the disqualification mentioned in section 53 (1) (c) did not operate at the time when the conviction and sentence were sub-judice particularly on appeal inasmuch as appeal is a statutory right given to the convict. We also think that the words 'sentence to imprisonment for a term of not less than six months" and" has elapsed from the date of the expiration of the sentence" occurring in clause (e) indicate that the disqualification spoken of applies when a conviction and sentence has become final either on the appeal or on the expiration of the period of limitation prescribed for appeal with the result that the execution of the sentence has become inevitable."
